source_caption_text:
Never forget when Drake joined Druski’s Instagram Live and left after getting a look at his room 😭😂

Via; @druski / @champagnepapi 

What started as a casual conversation turned into an accidental room inspection when Drake noticed the mess in the background. Druski was there to talk, but the room ended up becoming the main attraction, and Drake’s quick exit made the whole interaction even funnier.

The timing is what makes this clip so good. No skit, no elaborate setup, just a conversation taking a completely unexpected turn. Druski usually has everybody else laughing, but this time he was the one getting roasted 😂

Imagine getting on Live with Drake and your room being the reason he leaves 😭🛏️
